name: Temple Hall
desc1: The hall's lofty roof is supported by graceful soaring archways, and
desc2: the walls are crafted of white marble run through with silver streaks.
desc3: Bright lamps line the walls, illuminating every dark corner here. A
desc4: wide passageway to the east leads to the Temple's foyer, and from
desc5: there out onto the street. To the south, you can see the Priest spell
desc6: shop, and to the north, the Temple's Healer. The large hall continues
desc7: to the west, at the end of which is the chapel.
